item.description: SEDEMAC Mechatronics is selling its shares in the price band of Rs 1,287-1,352 apiece, applied for a minimum of 11 shares and its multiples to raise Rs 1,087 crore between March 04-06.

item.title: CBSE postpones March 5–6 board exams in Middle East until further notice, new dates to be announced
item.description: The Board informed principals of CBSE-affiliated schools in Bahrain, Iran, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE that the examinations planned for Thursday, March 5, 2026 and Friday, March 6, 2026 stand deferred
